about: A small coding agent that can read a repo, plan, edit files and run tests. The goal is a coding agent used every day, not a Cursor competitor.

features.title: Explores, then edits
features.body: Reads the repo, plans, makes minimal edits and runs commands.

features.title: Guardrails on commands
features.body: A command deny-list plus confirmation before anything risky runs.

features.title: Gitignore-aware context
features.body: It reads only what the task needs, respecting your .gitignore.

features.title: Zero dependencies
features.body: HTTP through urllib and JSON through json: nothing to pip install.

features.title: Local and free
features.body: Uses a local Ollama model (qwen3:8b by default) with no API keys; any OpenAI-compatible endpoint also works.

features.title: All milestones done
features.body: M0 to M4 are complete: a working agent you can use today.
